dataman - Interactive Image Display Client

Version 0.2.1

Author:
R. Pogge, OSU Astronomy Dept. (pogge@astronomy.ohio-state.edu)
Date:
2005 May 31

Usage

Usage: dataman [rcfile]

Where: rcfile is an optional runtime config file to load.

By default, dataman uses the runtime config file defined by DEFAULT_RCFILE in the client.h header.

Introduction

...

Commands

These are the interactive commands for dataman: 
  info           - report client information
  version        - report dataman version & compile info
  reset          - reset runtime & controller parameters
  verbose        - toggle verbose output mode
  debug          - toggle debugging output
  quit           - quit dataman
  history        - show command history
  !!             - repeat last command
  !cmd           - repeat last command matching 'cmd'
  help or ?      - view this list
Note that all commands are case-insensitive.

Runtime Configuration File

This is a typical runtime config file for the dataman agent: 
#
# dataman client runtime config file
#
# R. Pogge, OSU Astronomy Dept.
# pogge@astronomy.ohio-state.edu
# 2005 June 6
#
################################################################

# dataman's ISIS client info (Host=localhost is implicit)

ID   DM
Port 10801

# Application Mode: either STANDALONE or ISISclient

Mode Standalone
#Mode ISISclient

# ISIS Server Info - only releveant if Mode=ISISclient

ISISID   IS
ISISHost localhost
ISISPort 6600

# Data Transfer parameters.  Always define ImgPath

ImgPath /data/observer

doTransfer
SrcPath /rawdata
noclobber
mark

# Image Display parameters

doDisplay
AppName xtv
WinName Y4KCam Image Display
NCols  800
NRows  800
NColors 256
Zoom 4
#Flip
#IBW

# PostProcessing Commands (done in the order below)
# argument is always the transferred FITS image file

PostProc /home/dts/bin/fixY4khead %s
PostProc /home/dts/bin/autolog %s
PostProc lpr -Pbits -s %s

# Client Runtime flags 

VERBOSE
#nolog
#debug

Note that all parameter names are case-insensitive.

Notes

This application uses the ISISclient library (link).
